title: Financial calculations with Decimal.js
description: Implement calculateLoadFinancials using Decimal.js with banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Supports COMPANY_ASSET and EXTERNAL_CARRIER financial flows. Handles the feeIncludesAccessorials flag. Rejects OWNER_OPERATOR with a typed error. TDD approach: write tests first based on the success criteria in the PRD, then implement. See TDD §7 for the full implementation reference and PRD §Business Model for rules. File: hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/financials.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: calculateLoadFinancials accepts { customerRate, accessorials, loadedMiles, carrier: { type, dispatchFeePercent, partnerSplitPercent, feeIncludesAccessorials } }
Returns { customerRate, accessorials, dispatchFee, partnerSplit, companyShare, totalRevenue, ratePerMile } — all as strings (decimal serialization)
GIVEN customerRate=$2800, accessorials=$0, feePercent=10%, splitPercent=50%, feeIncludesAccessorials=false THEN dispatchFee='280.00', partnerSplit='140.00', companyShare='140.00'
GIVEN customerRate=$2800, accessorials=$200, feePercent=10%, splitPercent=50%, feeIncludesAccessorials=true THEN dispatchFee='300.00' (fee on $3000 base)
GIVEN COMPANY_ASSET carrier THEN totalRevenue = customerRate + accessorials
GIVEN EXTERNAL_CARRIER carrier THEN totalRevenue = dispatchFee
GIVEN OWNER_OPERATOR carrier type THEN throws typed error 'Not yet implemented'
Uses banker's rounding (half to even): e.g., 2.225 rounds to 2.22, 2.235 rounds to 2.24 (per cross-feature decision L-002)
All test cases pass before implementation code is written (TDD RED phase)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest --coverage src/shared/financials && npx tsc --noEmit
